caption: The drawing features three marionette-like puppets suspended by strings against a light-colored, plain background. The largest puppet is positioned centrally and upside-down, with dark hair, a purple and black dress with layered ruffles, pink blush on its face, and hands hanging down. Its legs, covered in blue stockings and red shoes, are wrapped around a horizontal stick as if swinging from it. To the upper left, there is a smaller puppet sitting on a swing composed of red and white horizontal stripes, dressed in a grayish blouse, and tan legs with small black shoes. Below and slightly to the left, a third puppet is depicted in much smaller scale, also hanging upside-down and mirroring the posture and outfit of the central figure. The marionette strings are depicted as black lines running vertically through the image, emphasizing the puppets' suspended state. The overall composition is arranged to draw attention to the central, largest figure with supporting, smaller renditions of the other marionettes on the left side.
title: Marylin, the Trapeze Artist
